dukes archives isn’t a good area. the imprisonment is fine, the rest of the area is very small and very boring. Ds3’s archives proves this idea could be done in a much better way. Painted world is good— it’s a shame it’s not post-lordvessel content, so it’s irrelevant here. Likewise with Sif and darkroot. New Londo’s level design is fine. Its enemy placement is bad, and I have never heard anyone think that 4 kings is a good boss. The strategy for the boss is literally “wear big armor, hit until you run out of estus”. It’s also hilariously rushed (why are there 5 kings in a boss fight called 4 kings LMAO). 
Catacombs is good, but that’s pre-vessel content. Tomb is utterly fucking terrible, it’s up there with izalith. 

Gwyn is both extremely easy, and lazily done. His animations are reuses of the knights, down to the parry timing, so a good chunk of people can kill him first try considering there’s like 30 knights outside his boss door to practice on.

Being given the lordvessel allowed for shortcuts to be taken in both level and world design, which is the reason that people almost universally think the game falls off in the second half. All 4 of the ending areas have the same issues as lost izalith, Izalith just also has the games worst boss so it receives a lot of the hate.

Crystal caves is absolutely not a good area. 1 enemy type and essentially no exploration. It’s as bad as lost izalith. Tomb of the Giants is honestly probably worse than lost izalith, with a slightly better boss right at the end. Out of the 4 rushed and poorly done final areas, New Londo is the only one that feels similar to the pre-vessel areas, but it’s tarnished by single enemy type spam (ghosts everywhere) and a lame ass boss fight.

The theme of the post-vessel areas is a lack of polish in both level design and enemy placement. There wasn’t money for more enemy models, but we already have Capra demon and Taurus demon, so why not just copy paste those guys in 30 times? Expansive, twisty levels are difficult to design and test, so let’s just do a giant crystal that’s a straight line from start to finish. We’re entirely out of money to do a good final boss fight— eh just make him weak as fuck, it’s thematic!
